cohort: Six first-attempt pairs on six distinct hardware boot IDs and runner identities. Alternating PC/CP order fixed by rank before dispatch. One pair per independent host. The separate pilot contributes no confirmation observation.
threshold: Primary endpoint is the first unchanged ordinary Cargo. Every pair must use at least 20% fewer hardware instructions on C; two-sided exact paired sign p <=0.05; paired median and exact median interval [min,max] with 96.875% coverage for n=6. Further warm repetitions are within-host controls. Genuine edit must save work on every host. Old and independent clean result must each stay within 2% of parent on each boot.
guards: All previous source, physical SDK, registry, stale test verdict, real E0308, repaired and independent clean, raw ELF, four correct untraced counters, and separately repeated exec census/retained actual Wild input gates must independently reopen. In addition all 2,454 names and both complete state-specific ELFs must equal the frozen pilot bytes on all six boots, with one ordinary storage copy per product. The full edited census must show 4 rustcs vs 1, 1 Wild in both roles, unchanged 4 rustcs + 1 Wild vs zero rustc/zero Wild.
